subject.title: [Feature]: Self-hosted STT/TTS provider support in webchat (Route webchat TTS through the gateway instead of browser Speech API)

question: Should WebChat voice support be split into gateway-backed per-message TTS and a batch editable dictation flow through `tools.media.audio`, with this issue kept as the canonical umbrella until those slices land?
rationale: The source evidence shows partial primitives and open implementation candidates, but the permanent UX/API boundary for STT versus realtime Talk needs maintainer product direction before automation should create another fix PR.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Split Slices
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the TTS PR and the editable dictation PR as separate, gateway-backed pieces using existing config surfaces.

options.title: Narrow To STT Only
options.body: Declare current TTS/audio playback sufficient for now and retitle or replace this issue with a focused editable dictation requirement.

options.title: Defer WebChat Voice Provider Work
options.body: Close or pause the webchat-specific voice-provider push and rely on Talk/file-upload/manual recorder paths until a broader voice roadmap is approved.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Split Slices
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the TTS PR and the editable dictation PR as separate, gateway-backed pieces using existing config surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The TTS candidate branch and maintainer-labeled related work make this the clearest current routing owner for the product decision.
